# Security

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report it privately through [GitHub's vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/cutenode/localnetwork/security/advisories/new). Please don't open an issue or pull request for it.

## What's supported

- locallibrary: the latest release.
- localtoolbox: the latest build of `main`.
- Local Network: the live site at [localnetwork.computer](https://localnetwork.computer).

Fixes go into the next release or build. Older versions don't get them.

## What to include

- Which tool and version (`locallibrary --version`, the number on the extension's card in `chrome://extensions`, or the page on the site).
- What an attacker could do, and what they'd need first.
- Steps to reproduce it, or a proof of concept.
- Your operating system and browser, if they matter.

Edit out tokens, passwords and anything else private from logs and screenshots before you send them.
